sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: You know these questions from Units 1–4. Hungarian asks with a question word at the front: *ki?* for a person, *mi?* for a thing, *hol?* for a place, *hány?* for a number. Nothing else changes: there is no word for "do". The key word of the answer then sits right before the verb: *Hol laksz? Budapesten lakom.* To ask a personal detail with *mi*, put the noun with its ending after *a*: *Mi a címed?*

sections.title: Question words
rows: Who are you? / Who is he or she?

sections.content: English needs "do" in *Where do you live?* Hungarian does not: *Hol laksz?* is just the question word and the verb.
